corpus.rationale: System recall index with explicit memory-layer policy and workspace inventory.
corpus.semanticMix: Topology facts plus durable memory-layer rules.
mustCaptureClaims: System Memory is the workspace recall index for OpenClaw.
Generated memory must not flatten authored docs.
The memory layers include human-owned sources, DB-backed model-memory projection, and daily memory files as an ingestion layer.

corpus.rationale: Deployment policy surface with strong normative language and stable operational facts.
corpus.semanticMix: Rules first, then deployment facts and references.
mustCaptureClaims: OpenClaw should converge toward one canonical repo checkout, runtime container, and runtime image.
Deployment sprawl is drift, not harmless clutter.
Active runtime assets must not be pruned casually.

corpus.rationale: Core model-memory architecture doc that mixes descriptive pipeline facts with explicit non-goals.
corpus.semanticMix: Architecture facts plus some boundary rules.
mustCaptureClaims: The runtime pipeline is identical for supported source types after source adaptation.
Semantic truth lives only in canonical memory objects.
Detector-era modules and family registries are non-goals.

corpus.rationale: Direct test of class-vs-kind semantics and migration rules.
corpus.semanticMix: Schema migration rules with supporting facts.
mustCaptureClaims: Kind should become the primary semantic discriminator.
CanonicalClass should be secondary or derived.
Phase 2 should begin by keeping both fields while demoting class logically.

corpus.rationale: Strong normative contract around read-vs-ingest arbitration with bounded scope rules.
mustCaptureClaims: Use the paginated reader first for immediate answerability.
Trigger ingest only when there is clear value beyond the current answer.
The current implementation only applies to host-side reads inside the active workspace root.

corpus.rationale: Topology policy with canonical project list and compatibility-alias rules.
mustCaptureClaims: Docs/projects surfaces are the only canonical project workspaces.
Workspace projects should usually be import-backed compatibility aliases.
Projects/ops is the justified writable exception.

corpus.rationale: Automation lane with stable asset references and live-contract rules.
mustCaptureClaims: The GitHub digest lane is scoped to openclaw/openclaw.
The live webhook-ingest workflow is published and active on the public Funnel endpoint.
Future restoration work should extend this lane from committed assets rather than runtime-only host survival.

corpus.rationale: Dense normative contract with explicit required fields and required sections.
corpus.semanticMix: Rules first, with some reference facts.
mustCaptureClaims: Every external skill review must end in a durable operator-facing report.
The report must live under docs/projects/skills-system/skill-vetting/reports.
Runtime surface proof must record availability and proof commands for openclaw and clawhub surfaces.

corpus.rationale: Delegation policy doc with clear when-to / when-not-to routing rules.
corpus.semanticMix: Delegation rules, procedural request shape, and a few reference facts.
mustCaptureClaims: Web-researcher is the designated external public-web retrieval surface.
Explicit URL or read-this-page tasks should default to a fresh temporary web-researcher session.
Delegation requests should be bounded and include objective, required_fields, and desired_output_shape.

corpus.rationale: Checklist-heavy document that should stress procedure capture and rule vs fact separation.
corpus.semanticMix: Procedures with some gating rules and deployment facts.
mustCaptureClaims: The checklist must be executed in order with verification gates before proceeding.
Step 1 requires applying and verifying the intake routing schema SQL.
Step 2 requires importing the Intake Router workflow into n8n but not activating it yet.

variants.hypothesis: A bounded canonicalization simplification helps beyond prompt-only changes by removing the model burden of class assignment and normalizing brittle rule payload output.
variants.simplificationTested: Prompt simplification plus a canonicalization normalizer that derives canonicalClass from kind/sourceKind and repairs minimal rule payload shape.
filesChanged: semantic_extraction prompt contract at candidate stage
semantic_extraction prompt contract at canonicalization stage
intentionallyNotChanged: No new deterministic heuristics beyond bounded canonicalization normalization.
